paragraphs: By way of introduction, my name is Joshua Chappell. My intent is to apply for the Growth Marketing & Operations Partner at Vici Media. I feel I have a lot of immediate value I can bring to your organization.

You want someone who leverages AI workflows daily rather than someone who knows what AI is. That is how I already work. At Charter One I used Claude agentic coding to build content workflows that cut production times in half, and through my own company I slashed creative production by 30% using AI across the pipeline. Those workflows sit next to real campaign results: a 200% lift in ad click-through rates and a social initiative that drove 20x the engagement of standard content.

The operations half of this role is familiar too. I have run my own company for six years, which means turning a loose goal into a plan, building the system, managing the budget and the vendors, and closing the gap before anyone has to ask. I hold a Master's in Marketing with a specialization in Marketing Analytics, so the numbers guide the decisions rather than decorate them.
I appreciate that you value autonomy, adaptability, and total ownership of your domains; these are all values that I strive to emulate.
Thank you for taking the time out of your busy day to read my letter. I look forward to the opportunity of doing an interview with you.

reference.jd_source: The original posting was not saved word for word when this application was built on 2026-08-11. Below is the detailed record of the posting saved at the time. The live posting may have changed or closed.
reference.jd_text:
## Application Details
- **Company:** Vici Media
- **Location:** Remote (US time zones preferred)
- **Type:** Full-time
- **Pay:** $65,000 – $85,000/year + quarterly performance bonus tied to role and department goals
- **Application requires:** Resume **plus** a 2-paragraph response describing a favorite AI tool or prompt workflow. See `6-ai-workflow-response.md`.

## Key Responsibilities
**Growth marketing**
- Own internal campaigns from concept to execution with brand consistency.
- Scale corporate social presence via **Sprout Social** — scheduling, listening, audience growth, engagement tracking.
- Audit digital performance in **Google Analytics**; build attribution models and optimize ROI.
- Build and manage **Salesforce** dashboards and reports for lead flow, conversions, pipeline visibility.
- Experiment with and integrate **AI tools** for content, reporting, data tracking, and pipeline optimization.

**Strategic operations**
- Turn big-picture strategy and loose concepts into structured project plans.
- Own ad-hoc special projects; find bottlenecks and streamline internal workflows.
- Track deliverables, manage shifting priorities, resolve hurdles before executive intervention.

## Qualifications
- **2–5 years** blended performance digital marketing, growth operations, or strategic support
- **Hands-on Sprout Social and Google Analytics — "strictly required"**
- Functional Salesforce report/dashboard experience (admin/coding not required)
- Practical AI workflow experience: automated reporting, programmatic content generation, prompt engineering
- Strong written/verbal communication; poise with leadership

## What They Offer
Total ownership of domains · performance incentives on department goals · freedom to adopt new marketing tech and AI stacks · direct proximity to leadership and mentorship

## Company
Vici Media — described only as "a dynamic, fast-paced, high-growth collaborative workplace."

research.overview: Two US companies use the name "Vici Media", and the saved posting does not say which one this is. The likely match is Vici Media Inc. (vicimediainc.com), a Philadelphia company founded in 2014. It sells white-label digital advertising to local media companies and independent agencies: media planning, ad buying, reporting and sales training. It is small: LinkedIn lists 11-50 employees and PitchBook lists about 46. In June 2024 a private equity firm, Rockbridge Growth Equity, bought a majority stake. The founders still run the company, with Todd Schumacher as CEO and Megan Malone as COO. The posting's focus on Salesforce pipeline dashboards and a corporate social presence fits a business that sells to other businesses like this one. The other company is Vici Media Group, a Republican political consulting firm in Austin, Texas. No employee reviews were found for either company on Glassdoor, Indeed or Reddit. Most search results were for Vice Media or VICI (a clothing retailer), which are different companies.

glassdoor.summary: No Glassdoor page for either Vici Media company turned up. The Glassdoor results belonged to other companies: Vice Media (about 3.2/5 from about 620 reviews) and VICI the retailer (2.9/5 from 43 reviews). Those ratings do not apply here and should not be used.

indeed.summary: No Indeed reviews were found for Vici Media. Indeed results were for Vice Media and for a different company called Vici in Walnut, CA (2.8/5 from 17 reviews), neither of which is this employer. The Indeed connector failed to connect today, so its company-data lookup could not be run.

reddit.summary: Searches, including site:reddit.com, returned no Reddit threads about either Vici Media company.

pros.point: Small and run by its founders. The founders kept stakes and still run the business after the 2024 investment, so the 'direct proximity to leadership' in the posting is believable.
New growth funding: Rockbridge Growth Equity made a majority investment in June 2024. That fits the 'high-growth' wording and the creation of a new growth-marketing role.

An established business, not a startup: running since 2014. A vendor case study says Vici handles digital marketing for 170+ partner companies and manages 1,200+ campaigns a month. These are the company's own marketing figures.
The company's own site says it was named one of Philadelphia's Best Places to Work. No year or awarding group is given, so this could not be verified.
Customers seem happy: Birdeye shows 5 stars from 118 reviews. These are client reviews, not employee reviews.

Salary.com's Vici Media Inc profile has positive employee comments about communication, friendly colleagues and training. The evidence is weak: the same text repeats and the dates do not match (2024 and 2025).

cons.point: No independent employee reviews exist on Glassdoor, Indeed or Reddit. Culture, management quality and turnover cannot be checked from outside. Searches only turned up companies with similar names.

Which company this is has not been confirmed. Vici Media Group in Austin is a political consulting firm. News reports from 2019-2020 say it built fake websites in Democratic candidates' names. Confirm the employer is the Philadelphia ad-tech company before going further.

A private equity firm has owned a majority since June 2024. That usually means firm growth targets and a possible later sale. The quarterly bonus tied to department goals fits that pattern. How this affects daily work is unknown.
Very small team (about 11-50 people). A 'partner' role here likely has no support staff and covers marketing, operations and special projects at once.
Headquarters are in Philadelphia (Eastern time). Arizona is 2-3 hours behind Eastern time, so expect early-morning meetings from Mesa.

One directory (Flexable) lists a 1.0 average rating for Vici Media, Inc. It gives no review count and does not say whether the ratings came from clients or employees. Treat it as unverified, but note it.

red_flags: Two different companies are named Vici Media. Confirm this employer is the Philadelphia ad-tech firm (vicimediainc.com), not the Austin political consulting firm.
There are no employee reviews anywhere. Ask in the interview about turnover and what happened to the last person in this role.
The posting was not found live on ZipRecruiter or Dice on 2026-10-14, so it may be closed.
research.bottom_line: Very little is public about working at Vici Media. The likely employer is a small, founder-run Philadelphia ad-tech firm, majority-owned by private equity since 2024, with no independent employee reviews. Its 'Best Places to Work' claim could not be verified. That is not a reason to skip it. Confirm which Vici Media this is, ask about turnover and how the quarterly bonus is paid, and treat the culture as unknown until he talks to people who work there.
